villageInformation.heroDescription: Discover the history, identity, facilities and development of our village.
villageInformation.introTitle: Gram Panchayat: The Foundation of Local Self-Governance
villageInformation.introDescription: The Gram Panchayat is a local self-government institution responsible for carrying out development activities and providing public services at the village level using the powers granted by the state government.
villageInformation.introDescription2: With the cooperation of elected representatives, including the Sarpanch and Gram Panchayat members, and administrative staff, the institution addresses the everyday needs of villagers. It plays an important role in water supply, healthcare, sanitation, education and the development of village infrastructure. Active participation of local residents helps ensure effective decision-making, development planning and implementation.
villageInformation.location: Taluka Anjangaon Surji, District Amravati, Maharashtra
villageInformation.cardCaption: A village committed to development, public participation and good governance.
villageInformation.profileDescription: Important information about the geographical location and identity of Gram Panchayat Sategaon.
villageInformation.featuresDescription: Our village values agriculture, community participation, environmental protection and transparent local governance.
villageInformation.facilitiesDescription: Basic facilities and public services that support the everyday lives of villagers.
villageInformation.locationDescription: Gram Panchayat Sategaon is located in Anjangaon Surji Taluka of Amravati District in Maharashtra, India.
villageInformation.closingDescription: With the active participation of citizens and the effective implementation of development initiatives, we are working towards a clean, progressive and self-reliant village.
